definitions.explanation: To position oneself facing a particular direction or thing.

definitions.gloss: to head toward, to go toward
definitions.explanation: To proceed in the direction of a destination.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xに{向|む}かう (face toward X / head toward X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing movement or state. {向|む}かっている = 'is heading toward' or 'is facing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xに{向|む}かう (head toward X, face X)
・{向|む}かい{合|あ}う (face each other)
・{向|む}かって{右|みぎ} (on your right as you face it)
・{向|む}かい{側|がわ} (opposite side)
・{未来|みらい}に{向|む}かう (face the future)

RELATED:
・{向|む}く: to turn, to face (more general)
・{向|む}ける: to turn something toward (transitive)
・{向|む}かい: opposite, facing (noun)
